import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Convert 'model_year' to a categorical type for better plotting
df['model_year'] = df['model_year'].astype(str)

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Initialize the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a scatter plot
scatter = sns.scatterplot(x='weight_grams', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', size='megapixels',
                          sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.7, palette='viridis', data=df)

# Customize the plot
scatter.set_title('Digital Cameras: Weight vs Price')
scatter.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
scatter.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
scatter.legend(title='Sensor Type & Megapixels', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
